method: V08's own stated heuristic, applied as MY reading of it, not as a coded course rule
heuristic: V08 [00:36:15]-[00:36:16]: 'The fast move is false. The slow and steady move is the correct move.' Applied here as: if the approach INTO the entry is FAST relative to the day's other bars, treat the down move as false and expect the reversal (TARGET). If the approach is a slow, steady grind, treat the down move as real and expect continuation through the entry (STOP).
declared_limitation: 'Fast' has no definition anywhere in V08 (A-061). The operationalisation above is MINE. It is used to make a personal prediction in a comprehension exercise; it is NOT a coded rule, it does NOT enter any spec, and no result here may be cited as a measurement of the course's rule (D-010, D-030).
expected_difficulty: PT-034 measured the base rate for exactly this entry at 70-77% TARGET. An always-TARGET guess therefore scores about 0.75. I am predicting only 5 of 12 TARGET, which is a deliberately discriminating call: if the heuristic carries no information I should LOSE to the baseline, and I expect that is more likely than not.
